decisions.description: Keep add.js as a minimal pure function `export function add(a, b) { return a + b; }` with no input validation.
decisions.rationale: Matches the stated objective and existing test imports, avoids unrequested behavior changes, and keeps the diff minimal; validation can be added later if a type contract is specified.
